reviews.title: I paid for no ads
reviews.text: This game is cheating me. I payed for No Ads and still have ads. I tried to ask a question in the Settings but that is impossible to get a question for review!!!

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text: This is a really good game … keeps my brain working … and I need that at my age.   The ads aren’t too bad (not enough for me to consider deleting the game) and I have deleted many games even though I throughly enjoyed them just because of the constant ads.  I would definitely recommend this game.  BTW … this is the FIRST time I have ever written a review for a game.

reviews.title: A Brain in Red Lipstick.
reviews.text: It’s fast, it’s clever, and it has the audacity to assume you can keep up. And you will, because nothing feels better than outsmarting a timer that thinks it’s the boss.

reviews.title: Easy questions, annoying pop up for a different game
reviews.text: The only thing challenging about this game is staying patient and engaged when mid game  a pop up a option to download Majong interrupts and lingers.

reviews.title: Ms Piper
reviews.text: Great game but ads pull it way down. I had deleted it from my games due to commercials & questions. Mostly the ads. It popped up & I thought give it another try. So the questions are better & the age question maybe the answer. Lower amount of ads. Then your product would be worth keeping.

reviews.title: Fun game but gets repetitive
reviews.text: I’ve enjoyed the questions and pattern of the game. I think it was only level 45 where I started getting repeat questions.  There should be enough topic to get through thousands of levels before reusing an identical question.

reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text: It’s ok, but the clip they use to lure you in is not what you get & then you get ads for different games using the same clip. Why can’t developers just be honest about what you’re getting? Smdh…
